title: Amazing experience and incredible photos afterwards. A must do!
text: My wife and I booked this experience with Adolfo, and we were very glad we did. Adolfo met us in the city center and made us feel right at home in minutes. He was warm and friendly, and made sure we felt comfortable walking through the city and in front of the camera. We ventured through the city and into the Albaicin. Adolfo took us to hidden local spots that made for great photo shoots. We then comfortably ventured far into the Albaicin and it was the coolest experience. While we knew we had many great pictures on the way, we couldn't stop thanking Adolfo for a great day! Please book this ex
author: 6907erics

title: Super Bien!!
text: My actual goal was to get new photos for my CV and I normally feel uncomfortable in front of cameras so I was a bit nervous going into the shooting. But I am 100% happy that I did it and I had a lot of fun with Adolfo exploring unknown parts of Granada and getting amazing pictures. I would recommend it 100% to everyone looking for nice pictures, a charming tourguide and a bit of adventure!
author: Roam245347
